products.name: Jamf AI Governance
products.note: Native AI control plane for macOS fleets, GA July 1, 2026; discovery and policy enforcement for on-device and cloud AI use on Mac endpoints

profile_text.body:
Jamf is a company specializing in Apple device management and security, describing itself as helping organizations manage Apple devices, connect users to resources, and protect against cyber threats. The company states it has over 20 years of experience and claims an unmatched reputation for same-day Apple OS support. It serves organizations ranging from small businesses to large enterprises managing tens of thousands of Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Vision Pro, and Apple TV devices, and positions itself as the only company providing a complete management and security solution for an Apple-first environment. IDC MarketScape has placed Jamf in the Leaders Category for Worldwide Unified Endpoint Management Software for Apple Devices in its 2025–2026 Vendor Assessment.

On the AI side, Jamf has a tracked product called Jamf AI Governance, described as a native AI control plane for macOS fleets with discovery and policy enforcement for on-device and cloud AI use on Mac endpoints, with general availability scheduled for July 1, 2026. This product falls within the AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms category, reflecting Jamf's move to give organizations visibility and control over how AI tools are used across their Apple device fleets.
